newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Mota placed at 2,950 esc/shr.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Mota placed at 2,950 esc/shr.

text.p: Banco Essi said on Monday it placed 4.36 million shares in construction group Mota & Companhia among domestic and international institutions at 2,950 escudos ($16.33) per share.
Mota shares stood at 2,950 escudos, down 50, in volume of 4,360,641 at 0945 GMT.

Parallel to the share offering, Mota is increasing its capital from the present level of six billion escudos to 14 billion escudos via the issue of eight million ordinary shares, reserved for current shareholders, a Banco Essi official said.
The price fixed in the share offering is equal to the price in the capital increase, that is 2,950 escudos per share.
About 30 percent of the capital of Mota will have been redistributed after the share placement and capital increase.
The subscription period for the capital increase runs from July 18 to August 1.
